events.event: MPR's verification team said it will not visit the schools of VP candidates Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono and will instead verify their diplomas in Jakarta via the Kemendikdasmen, with only high-school diplomas checked.
events.key_numbers: 2 candidates · verification 23 Nov-1 Dec · MPR plenary vote 9-11 Dec (date reported differently, see E1088/E1013) · MPR said both may stay ministers
events.why_it_matters: After Gibran's diploma saga, how the MPR checks the next VP's diplomas is the live question.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA politik feed has 8+ items on the cawapres process in one morning

events.event: Polri dismissed Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo, a suspect in the alleged treason (makar) plot involving ex-Kapolri Listyo Sigit, from the force after an ethics hearing; he is reported to have appealed, and AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra was also dismissed for helping him shadow an official.
events.key_numbers: Tedjo Kusumo (ex-Densus 88 intelligence director) dismissed 24 Nov · AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra also dismissed · Tedjo is 1 of 6 named makar suspects (E1087)
events.why_it_matters: Another general is out of Polri as the makar case against the former police chief moves from suspects to sanctions.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNN, Detik, Suara, Kompas TV, Jawapos, Viva, Inilah within a day

events.event: Kadivpropam said ex-Kapolri Listyo Sigit will go through his ethics hearing (KKEP) on Thursday 26 November, over the alleged illegal wiretapping case.
events.key_numbers: Hearing Thu 26 Nov 2026 · prior dismissals in related cases: Ahrie Sonta (10 Nov), Eko Hadi Santoso (17 Nov), Tedjo Kusumo (24 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: The outcome decides whether a former national police chief is dishonourably discharged.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA politik feed; part of the dominant Polri story this week

events.event: Bareskrim said suspects in the makar case carried out a conspiracy (permufakatan) and attacks on social media; Dasco visited Prabowo at Istana Merdeka the same evening.
events.key_numbers: Dasco at Istana Merdeka 24 Nov, about 22:00 WIB (CNN timestamp) · Golkar had not decided between Amran and Sugiono
events.why_it_matters: Shows how police describe the plot, and that Dasco, the earlier favourite for VP, is still talking to the President.

events.event: Former Army chief Dudung voiced support for reopening the KM 50 toll road case, per CNN Indonesia headline.
events.key_numbers: KM 50 case (2020 shooting of FPI members)
events.why_it_matters: A reopened KM 50 case would revisit one of the most contested police cases of recent years.

events.event: East Java labour groups plan a rally at the Governor's office on 25 November ahead of the UMK (district minimum wage) decision.
events.key_numbers: Rally 25 Nov 2026 · UMK to be set by East Java governor
events.why_it_matters: UMK decisions set the minimum pay for formal workers in each district for 2027.

events.event: TNI changed its official term for the OPM armed group in Papua to KEB, per ANTARA.
events.key_numbers: OPM renamed KEB (full expansion not confirmed from headline)
events.why_it_matters: The label the military uses shapes how Papua conflict is framed and handled.

events.event: KPK moved the detention of Fahd Arafiq to a hospital (bantaran) at RS Polri, and the wife and children of ex-BNPB head Lt Gen Suharyanto did not attend a KPK summons.
events.key_numbers: Fahd Arafiq treated at RS Polri · Suharyanto family absent from KPK exam on 24 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Tracks the KPK disaster-emergency procurement case that has reached a former agency head's family.

events.event: KPU asked DKPP to reject all complaints over the 'Pasal Gibran' issue and restore the commissioners' good name, while the DKPP chair asked complainants not to doubt its independence.
events.key_numbers: 4 ethics cases merged by DKPP (per E0958)
events.why_it_matters: The ruling could decide whether KPU members face sanctions over rules that let Gibran run.
